scope: Install the Liquid Glass desktop widget pack by default with an illustrated Desktop widgets step in the installer.
approval: Maintainer approved the pictured selector from PR #166 and explicitly requested enabling the pack by default and publishing the release.

checks.command: Tahoe focused installer wizard, widget bundle, Plasmoids, localization, package mapping and component manifest suite (569 passed). Wizard checks covered the Custom and Express defaults for both editions.

KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland: installer backend provisioned all 15 packages. Plasma discovered them and left placement to the user. Reinstallation with the pack disabled removed the theme-owned packages and preserved a local widget.
Golden Gate bootstrap, source archive and release workflow tests (66 passed).
Golden Gate staged source used its own wallpaper and launcher defaults and selected the desktop widget pack. Published Tahoe archive version, immutable commit, and SHA-256 verified.

coverage_limits: Plasma widget registration and installer lifecycle exercised on KDE neon 6.8.1 Wayland. Calendar, analog clock and timer were rendered for the desktop preview. The remaining widget packages were checked for registration. Historical galleries retain their original provenance.
